SEO Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

SEO Manager (AKA Digital Experience Manager, Associate Digital Experience Director)
As Search Engine Optimisation Manager, you’ll be focused on delivering best in class SEO driving business growth across a portfolio of clients. This requires strong experience in SEO strategy and implementation. A good understanding of Paid Search is also required to implement holistic search strategies. 

We’re looking for a talented Manager who is also a delight to work with, which usually includes: 

•	A degree in marketing, advertising, business or a related field 
•	+4 years of combined experience in organic and paid search, digital project management or account management 
•	Proven experience managing a team
•	Experience scoping projects, providing forecasts and driving ongoing process improvement
•	The ability to create and implement SEO strategies frameworks that successfully deliver incremental growth overtime. 
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills – and a knack for details
•	Experience developing content strategies and competitor analysis using a range of platform and technologies. 
•	Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously and make smart, fast decisions 
•	Knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, and CSS, with a focus on optimizing them for SEO
•	Stellar communication and presentation skills – you’re poised, articulate and convincing
•	Previous experience with SEO industry tools – i.e. Google Analytics, Omniture, Google Search Console, Brightedge, SEMRush, Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
Salary: $90K - $120K package

SEO Director (Digital Experience Director, Director of SEO, SEO Lead, Head of SEO)
As Director of SEO, you’ll grow the division and develop a strategic vision, whilst providing leadership to the team.  You’ll build the agency’s search practice (SEO) to support aggressive revenue growth.
 
Day to day, your responsibilities will include:
•	Directing long-term and short-term strategic marketing efforts to meet both market share and sales goals for clients via SEO strategies
•	Helping to assess and pursue new business opportunities while maintaining the company’s existing strengths 
•	Developing a world-class search marketing team that will scale and thrive as the business grows
•	Effectively using tools to automate and scale the business in an efficient, cost-effective manner 
•	Ensuring excellence and accuracy in all client deliverables and working with Managers/Directors to present them
•	Developing or approving all scopes of work that include search engine optimization
•	Collaborating with Delivery Managers on project timelines and with Staffing on resource needs
Salary: over threshold 

This role requires; deep familiarity with the digital environment and an understanding of business from both market and P&L perspectives, Strong analytical and problem solving skills, knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, and CSS and outstanding leadership and people management skills. 
All roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

result.description:
Position: Retail Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: IN2 FONES PTY LTD
Location: Mount Vernon NSW 2178
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
IN2 FONES PTY LTD is a dynamic and expanding telecommunications retail business that operates multiple Vodafone-branded stores and customer service operations across New South Wales. With a recent growth to approximately 10 stores, the company specialises in delivering high-quality mobile phones, tablets, smart watches, service plans, accessories, and repair services to a diverse customer base. Known for its strong focus on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and market competitiveness, IN2 FONES fosters a supportive and performance-driven workplace culture that values teamwork, professional development, and innovation in the fast-paced retail telecom sector.
About the Position:
The Retail Manager plays a pivotal leadership role in overseeing the day-to-day operations of three telecommunications retail stores within IN2 FONES PTY LTD. This position is responsible for driving sales, profitability, and operational efficiency while implementing strategic initiatives to enhance market presence and customer experience. The role is essential for supporting the company’s continued expansion and achieving business objectives in a competitive retail environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Direct and control the day-to-day operations of three telecommunications retail stores to ensure the achievement of sales, profitability and operational objectives.
Determine product mix, pricing strategies and stock levels for mobile phones, tablets, smart watches, telecommunications service plans, accessories and repair services in accordance with market demand and business objectives.
Develop and implement purchasing, sales and marketing strategies, including promotional campaigns and bundled product offers, to increase revenue and strengthen market competitiveness.
Manage procurement, inventory planning, stock control, stock reconciliation and loss prevention across all retail locations to ensure product availability and minimise inventory shrinkage.
Analyse sales reports, financial results and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify business trends, improve operational efficiency and maximise profitability.
Prepare and manage store budgets, monitor operating expenses and implement cost-control measures to achieve financial performance targets.
Recruit, supervise, train, roster and manage the performance of retail staff across all store locations to ensure operational efficiency and achievement of business objectives.
Oversee visual merchandising, product displays and promotional activities to maximise product visibility, sales performance and brand consistency.
Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, company policies, retail procedures and all relevant regulatory requirements.
Liaise with senior management to implement business strategies, improve operational processes and support the continued commercial growth of the business.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma level qualification (or equivalent).
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
Proven leadership and team management skills with the ability to recruit, train, motivate and develop retail staff.
Strong commercial acumen, including experience in sales target achievement, inventory management, budgeting, and profit optimisation.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-focused mindset and ability to build positive relationships.
Analytical skills to interpret sales data, KPIs, and financial reports to drive informed decision-making.
Knowledge of retail operations in telecommunications or a similar fast-paced consumer goods environment.
Commitment to compliance, workplace health and safety, and high ethical standards.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Regional Restaurant Manager – Bronte NSW

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working to assist our client who runs a highly regarded Brazilian restaurant group based in Bronte, NSW. Renowned for delivering authentic Brazilian cuisine while incorporating premium Australian ingredients, our client has built a strong reputation as one of Sydney's leading Brazilian dining destinations. Due to continued growth and expansion, an exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced Restaurant Manager to oversee the operations of multiple restaurant locations. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring operational excellence, maintaining consistent service standards, and driving the commercial success of multiple venues while supporting the continued growth of the business.

•	Location: Based in Bronte, NSW with travel across other venues as needed.

•	Employment Type: Full-time, ongoing

•	Salary: Negotiable in the range $140k – $145k per annum plus superannuation

Key responsibilities include:

•	Oversee the day-to-day operations of the base venue at Bronte and multiple restaurant locations, ensuring consistent service quality, food standards, and operational efficiency.

•	Lead, mentor, and support local Managers and restaurant teams to achieve business objectives and maintain a positive workplace culture.

•	Recruit, train, develop, and performance-manage management and front-of-house staff across all venues.

•	Develop staffing strategies and coordinate workforce planning, rostering, and labour cost management across multiple sites.

•	Monitor financial performance, including budgets, revenue, labour costs, food and beverage costs, and profitability, implementing strategies to improve results.

•	Analyse sales reports and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify trends and opportunities for business improvement.

•	Ensure compliance with food safety regulations, liquor licensing requirements, workplace health and safety legislation, and company policies across all locations.

•	Maintain exceptional customer service standards and promptly resolve customer feedback and operational issues.

•	Coordinate with kitchen leadership to ensure menu consistency, quality control, and efficient service delivery.

•	Work closely with senior management to develop and implement business growth strategies, promotional campaigns, and operational improvements.

•	Manage supplier relationships, inventory control, purchasing processes, and stock management across multiple venues.

•	Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure brand consistency, cleanliness, presentation, and compliance with company standards.

•	Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction, employee engagement, and operational performance.

•	Prepare regular operational and financial reports for senior management, providing recommendations to improve business outcomes.

Skills & Experience Required to be considered:

•	Diploma or higher in Business, Management, Commerce or a closely related discipline or agreed substitute.

•	Have at least 1, or more years (preferably more) professional experience managing multiple hospitality venues simultaneously.

•	Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing teams.

•	Excellent financial acumen, including budgeting, cost control, forecasting, and profitability management.

•	Thorough understanding of hospitality operations, food safety requirements, and workplace compliance.

•	Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

•	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing competing priorities across multiple locations.

•	Experience with hospitality POS systems, rostering software, and business reporting tools.

Smart Hill Constructions Pty Ltd 
(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience
•	At least three years of relevant experience preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation for residential and/or commercial building projects
•	Demonstrated proficiency using computer-aided drafting software such as AutoCAD, Revit or other comparable CAD/BIM platforms
•	Experience preparing and revising floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details and other technical documentation
•	Ability to interpret architectural concepts, engineering drawings and technical specifications and translate them into accurate construction documentation
•	Ability to communicate and coordinate drawings with architects, engineers, consultants and construction personnel throughout project delivery
•	Understanding of construction methods, building materials and document control procedures
•	Experience managing drawing revisions, version control and project documentation
•	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality technical drawings
•	Well-developed communication and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with all levels of stakeholders


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026 

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.
